text:
maria: quick sync — proposing a unified audit-log ingestion & cost-backstop policy for enterprise customers. TL;DR: default hot retention 90d, cold 365d; per-tenant ingestion alerts at $X/day; automatic throttle and canary for heavy tails. want feedback before i slot into roadmap.

aj: curious what $X is :) we should tie threshold to per-tenant committed spend + a buffer. also need a hard throttle that returns 429s, not silent drops.

maria: agree. proposal below — pick numbers later but want the shape. throttle tiers: 1) soft alert at 70% of budget -> notify tenant + sentry; 2) hard throttle at 110% -> 429 and route to fallback model. soft throttle should still allow exports.

kevin: important: SOC2/ISO customers will expect complete chain-of-custody for the retention windows we commit to. any sampling/default pruning must be opt-in for those accounts. legal hold must override retention and be exportable.

samira: ops note — we need a runbook for migration of existing long-tail tenants. if we flip defaults, runbook should include: announcement -> opt-out window -> backfill plan -> storage cost estimate -> rollback path.

luis: customers pushing for 2y hot retention on a few deals. we can offer as premium add-on but need clear unit economics and an SLA. can we expose per-tenant projection in the Console?

maria: yes — Console should show 30/90/365 projections and an "excess spend" forecast. acceptance criteria I'm thinking: 1) E2E export for legal hold tested, 2) BYOK-keystore handshake unaffected by audit exports, 3) billing shows per-tenant delta, 4) canary rollout on 5 tenants.

aj: config sketch (for infra team):
```yaml
audit_ingest_policy:
  default_retention:
    hot_days: 90
    cold_days: 365
  retention_override_for_soc2: true
  cost_backstop:
    soft_pct_of_commit: 0.7
    hard_pct_of_commit: 1.1
  throttle_behavior:
    soft: notify, mark-priority
    hard: 429, route: fallback-model
  export_window_days_default: 7
```

kevin: +1 to retention_override_for_soc2 = true. also need immutability flag on exported evidence and MD5/SHA256 manifest for proof. legal hold should be a boolean in the tenant manifest and write-protected.

samira: ops runbook bullets:
- announce to tenant owners / CS 30d before change
- enable telemetry sampling for 2w to estimate delta
- run backfill job with concurrency cap 20 -> monitor p95 latency
- revert cap if p95 > target (150ms)
- post-migration audit: verify counts, hashes

maria: product gating criteria:
- compliance test matrix green (SOC2/ISO scenarios)
- Console UI for projection + warning banners implemented
- Billing telemetry exposes "audit_ingest_bytes" per-tenant
- BYOK flow tested end-to-end with export under KMS constraints

luis: sales ask: need a short "what we ship" blurb for customers and a one-pager on lift + cost. i'll draft if you give me the numbers.

kevin: one more: retention encryption keys — if a tenant chooses BYOK, retained logs must be encrypted under tenant key AND we need a documented access path for forensics (how ops requests decrypted snapshots). add that to the runbook.

maria: noted. I'll add key escrow/attestation steps to runbook.

aj: ops/infra TODOs from this thread:
- implement cost_backstop metrics (prometheus + alerting)
- add throttle endpoint returning structured error (code + link to docs + estimated retry)
- storage lifecycle job to move hot->cold
- per-tenant projection API for Console

samira: i'll own rollout runbook + canary checklist. will set up a dry-run with 3 pilot tenants next sprint.

maria: thanks all. next steps: i'll draft a PR with exact thresholds and acceptance criteria, tag security/ops/legal, and schedule a 30min review Wed. :thumbsup:
